title: Rockwell & Blue Star Product Catalog Extractor Input

batchSize.title: Batch Size
batchSize.description: Number of products to process in this run. Default is 5 for low-cost pilot runs.

batchIndex.title: Batch Index (0-based)
batchIndex.description: 0-based batch index. Batch 0 with size 5 processes items 1-5. Valid range is dynamically calculated based on selected products and batch size.

brandFilter.title: Brand Filter
brandFilter.description: Filter the catalog by brand before batching.

startRow.title: Start Catalog Index (Optional)
startRow.description: Specific starting 1-based catalog_index (1 to 155). Overrides batchIndex if provided.

endRow.title: End Catalog Index (Optional)
endRow.description: Specific ending 1-based catalog_index (1 to 155). Overrides batchIndex if provided.

products.title: Custom Products Override (Optional)
products.description: Override the default canonical catalog with a custom array of products.

platforms.title: Enabled Platforms
platforms.description: Configure which platforms to search. Brand official sites are recommended for pilot runs.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent browser pages. Free tier recommends 2.

maxRequestsPerMinutePerDomain.title: Max Requests Per Minute Per Domain
maxRequestsPerMinutePerDomain.description: Strict token-bucket rate limit applied per target domain to prevent IP blocks.

maxCandidatesPerPlatform.title: Max Candidates Per Platform
maxCandidatesPerPlatform.description: Maximum search result candidates to inspect per platform before choosing best match.

pageTimeoutSecs.title: Page Timeout (Seconds)
pageTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout for navigation and selector waiting.

maxRetries.title: Max Retries
maxRetries.description: Max retries for transient network or timeout failures.

useAiExtraction.title: Use AI Extraction
useAiExtraction.description: Enable OpenAI structured output for spec normalization. Recommended FALSE during pilot to avoid API costs.

aiModel.title: AI Model
aiModel.description: OpenAI model to use if AI extraction is enabled.

minimumConfidenceToSaveAsMatch.title: Minimum Confidence for Match
minimumConfidenceToSaveAsMatch.description: Threshold (0.0 - 1.0) required to classify as match.

saveRawEvidence.title: Save Raw Evidence
saveRawEvidence.description: Save raw candidate title and text snippets in dataset records.

dryRun.title: Dry Run Mode
dryRun.description: Simulates catalog parsing, query building, and batch allocation without firing HTTP/browser requests.
